task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the curved black scanner with trigger, then pick the tea box, and use the curved black scanner with trigger to scan the tea box
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架拾取带有触发器的弧形黑色扫描仪，然后拾取茶叶盒，并使用带有触发器的弧形黑色扫描仪扫描茶叶盒
